title: Homelab maturity tiers
description: A layered reference architecture progressing from one useful host through separated storage and compute, resilient operations, and an optional AI workload plane.
heading: Add layers only when they earn their cost

nodes.title: Foundation · one maintained host
lines: Linux · Compose · private access · security updates · independent backup · restore proof

nodes.title: Separated roles
lines: Compute · storage · DNS and ingress · monitoring · explicit failure boundaries

nodes.title: Resilient operations
lines: Inventory · configuration as code · canary updates · off-site recovery · power plans

nodes.title: Optional AI workload plane
lines: Separate inference · provider boundary · guarded tools

footer: A smaller system with proven recovery is more mature than a larger system without it.
